title: "Contact"
---

## Start a conversation

[Open an issue in the AIML-SIG/pmx_benchmarks repository](https://github.com/AIML-SIG/pmx_benchmarks/issues/new) to suggest a benchmark, ask about eligibility, volunteer to review, or share feedback on the site. Include a short description of the pharmacometric question and how a benchmark could help. You do not need a complete submission to start the conversation.

A GitHub account is needed to post an issue or pull request. You can read the site and repository without an account.

Before submitting data, read [Scope & Eligibility](scope.qmd) and the [Submission Guide](submission-guide.qmd). For a completed contribution, [open a pull request](https://github.com/AIML-SIG/pmx_benchmarks/pulls) following the guide.

GitHub issues are public. If your question involves confidential data, describe the general problem without sharing the data and ask for a suitable way to discuss it.
